subject: chemistry
title: Mass Spec Mission: Fragments and m/z
welcome_lead: Identify molecules by their mass spectrum fingerprint.
meta_desc: A-Level chemistry adventure on mass spectrometry interpretation.
final_note: You read the m/z map of molecular ions.

concepts.def: M+ breaks into smaller cation + radical.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Rightmost significant peak (ignoring M+1, M+2) gives Mr of the molecule.

Loss of 15 from M+ = CH3 lost. Loss of 17 = OH. Loss of 29 = CHO or C2H5. Loss of 45 = COOH.

Cl gives M and M+2 peaks in 3:1 ratio (35Cl:37Cl ≈ 3:1).

Br gives M and M+2 in 1:1 ratio (79Br:81Br ≈ 1:1). Two Cl atoms give M, M+2, M+4 in 9:6:1.

Stages: ionisation (electron impact or electrospray), acceleration, flight tube, detection.

Lighter ions arrive first because KE = 1/2 mv^2; t depends on sqrt(m/z). Computer converts time to m/z.
